Common AC Error Codes & Fixes

Is your AC showing an error code? Here are some common issues. For a definite solution, call our experts for Central AC thermostat repair Vadodara or other complex issues.

Error Code Potential Problem Recommended Solution
E1 / F1 Faulty room temperature sensor Check sensor connections. If the problem persists, the sensor may need replacement. Call for Ductable AC repair near me in Vadodara.
E4 / F4 Indoor unit fan malfunction Ensure nothing is obstructing the fan. The fan motor might be faulty. Requires professional inspection.
E6 / CH05 Communication error between indoor/outdoor units This is a complex issue needing a certified technician to check wiring and PCB boards.
P4 Compressor issue (overheating or failure) Turn off the AC immediately to prevent further damage. This is a critical error needing emergency ductable AC repair Vadodara.
